title: Expressive Words
description: Count how many words can be stretched to match the target string s.
pseudocode:
1. Define check(word, target) function
2. Iterate through words list
3. For each word, compare character groups with target
4. If lengths match or target length >= 3 and >= word length, count it
5. Return count

steps.note: Comparing 'hello' with 'heeellooo'. Groups: (h,1/1), (e,3/3), (l,2/2), (o,3/3). All valid extensions.
Comparing 'hi' with 'heeellooo'. Group (i,1) vs (eee,3). Length 1 < 3 and not equal.
Comparing 'helo' with 'heeellooo'. Group (l,1) vs (ll,2). Target group size 2 is not >= 3 and not equal.
